response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.gender), ''), 'Unknown') AS gender_group, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.gender), ''), 'Unknown')), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders) AS avg_per_gender FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_orders) AS avg_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.invoiced_orders - b.avg_per_gender) AS avg_excess_over_gender_average FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE g.invoiced_orders > b.avg_per_gender;
